Abstract:
Summer residential research fellowships at the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution in Massachusetts support graduate students in any field sharing a common interest in the nonlinear dynamics of rotating, stratified fluids. These fields include classical fluid dynamics, oceanography, meteorology, geophysics, astrophysics, applied mathematics, engineering and physics oceanography, meteorology, geophysics, astrophysics, applied mathematics, engineering, and physics. Fellows pursue a research project under the supervision of the staff and present a lecture and a written report for a proceedings volume while in residence at Woods Hole. The fellowship offers support for ten weeks.
